result.justification: The research objective is clearly stated as the development and evaluation of a machine-learning model for classifying DENV serotypes. The methodology includes detailed descriptions of data acquisition, preprocessing, and model evaluation benchmarks.

objective_evidence.quote: We developed and evaluated a machine-learning model to classify DENV serotypes (DENV-1–4) directly from nucleotide sequence data.

method_evidence.quote: Cluster-aware train/test splits were constructed to ensure strict lineage independence.
